about_the_game:
A boy, a bear, and the long way home through memory.

Beyond the Hundred Acre is a minimalist puzzle-adventure where you guide a young boy and his loyal bear through a fading dream of childhood. With no combat or dialogue, the story unfolds through silent cooperation, environmental puzzles, and the quiet atmosphere of a forgotten forest.

🔹 Key Features

  • Two Characters, One Bond
    between a boy and a slow-moving bear. Use teamwork to climb ledges, move platforms, trigger switches, and solve environmental puzzles.

  • Thoughtful Puzzle Design
    Each puzzle is handcrafted and integrated into the environment—requiring intuition, timing, and cooperation instead of tutorials or UI hints.

  • A Story Told Without Words
    There’s no dialogue, cutscenes, or HUD. The emotional arc unfolds through movement, animation and lighting.

  • A Short, Complete Experience
    Designed to be finished in a single sitting: roughly 1 to 2 hours. Ideal for players seeking an emotional and compact narrative adventure.

  • Built for Immersion
    Full controller support, minimal UI

Quick Facts

  • Genre: Puzzle-Adventure, Atmospheric

  • Playtime: 60–90 minutes

  • Single Player: Yes

  • Combat: None

  • Engine: Unreal Engine 5

  • Languages: English (more TBA)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 950 / AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5120 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading.
